item.title: A Heatmap feature
item.description: While downloading the full set of available listings from Zillow is useful, raw data alone doesn’t tell much of a story. To make the insights more tangible, I built a visual layer on top of it—specifically, a pricing heatmap. The result instantly reveals how home prices spread across San Francisco. Here’s an example focused on listings between $600K and $1M.
